purpose: Development pilot plus nine additional dataset checks; descriptive audit, not a blinded benchmark
generation_inputs: CSV, mapped research paper; no codebook, README or Stata context
checks: Row/column counts agree with the complete CSV
Baseline and grounded generation reuse identical CSV sample and content profile
Quoted evidence and citation IDs validate
Describe the table's observation unit rather than every geography in the study
Do not confuse income quartiles, quintiles and percentiles
Do not transfer study-level numerical findings to CSV fields
Distinguish subset-specific adjustment from blanket adjustment claims
Compare substantive description claims with the separately held-out table codebook
reporting: Separate operational completion, structural validation, factual errors and missing information. Missing detail is not proof of an incorrect claim; passing citation checks is not proof of semantic accuracy.

pilot_codebook_correction.verified_wording: County-level life expectancy at age 40 is reported for men and women by national income quartile, with both race-adjusted and unadjusted estimates and their standard errors.
pilot_codebook_correction.scope: Manual reference correction only; the codebook is excluded from model requests. The main paper alone does not establish the unadjusted column mapping.
